sector_survival_note: The network security market is expected to continue growing, but Fortinet will face increasing competition from cloud security providers.
thesis_summary: Fortinet provides network security and threat intelligence solutions that ride the trend of increasing cybersecurity spending.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural change in the network security market, such as a major acquisition or a shift to cloud-based security solutions.
sentiment_note: Fortinet is a high-quality investment with a strong moat, but its valuation is rich, so a smaller starter position is recommended.
ten_k_highlights: Fortinet's revenue has been rising at a rate of 103.4% over the past 5 years.
The company's gross margin has been increasing, from 74.1% in 2018 to 80.0% in 2022.
Fortinet's return on invested capital (ROIC) has been rising, from 55.6% in 2018 to 76.0% in 2022.
valuation_note: FCF yield 2.6%, PEG 2.2, EV/EBITDA 44, P/S 16 — very richly valued — starter position only.
implied_growth_note: The price already assumes strong growth for a decade — accumulate slowly.
